business_problem: migrate a petabyte-scale insurance data estate fast enough to support near-real-time streaming, new AI workloads, and better claims and customer experiences without service disruption.
solution_summary: Aviva uses Snowflake on Snowflake to migrate a petabyte-scale insurance data estate fast enough to support near-real-time streaming, new AI workloads, and better claims and customer experiences without service disruption. Policy, risk, transaction, and customer data are centralized in Snowflake so business users and data teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. The platform also connects with AWS so upstream systems and downstream consumers stay aligned around the same governed data assets. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Aviva achieved 1.3 PB Of data migrated in just seven months and 8x Faster data processing speed.
